query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
village as "Village",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
to_char(due_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Vaccination due date",
vaccine_name as "Vaccine name",
vaccine_schedule as "Schedule",
vaccine_status as "Vaccine status"
from "reporting"."ds__patient_vaccinations_upcoming"
where
-- BL-006: when the user selects "yes", drop patients explicitly recorded as
-- resident in a country other than the home country and retain patients with
-- no recorded country
case
when 
:excludeNonHomeCountry = 'yes'
then country_id is null or country_id = 'country-Australia'
else true
end
and
-- BL-004: restrict to patients born within the supplied date range
date_of_birth >= 
:fromDate
and
date_of_birth <= 
:toDate
and
-- BL-005: optional filters -- each applies only when the user supplies a value
case
when 
:status is null then true
else vaccine_status = 
:status
end
and
case
when 
:category is null then true
else vaccine_category = 
:category
end
and
case
when 
:vaccine is null then true
else vaccine_name = 
:vaccine
end
and
case
when 
:villageId is null then true
else village_id = 
:villageId
end
-- BL-007: order by due date, then patient name and vaccine
order by due_date, last_name, first_name, vaccine_name
name: Upcoming vaccinations line list
notes: This report generates upcoming vaccination schedules for patients up to 18 years old by default or for patients born within the user-selected date range. Set the 'Exclude overseas patients' filter to Yes to drop patients whose recorded country of residence is set to an overseas country.

queryOptions.dateRangeLabel: Enter dates or leave blank for births in the past 18 years
